title: Heating and Escape of Confined Atoms Subject to Colored Noise
summary: The motion of a particle in a finite-depth confining potential, such as that of an electromagnetically trapped atom or ion, is approximately harmonic at low energy and softens as the escape energy is approached. When the particle is driven by a stochastic force, the heating and escape times depend sensitively on the noise power spectrum. We study escape times of particles in softening potentials driven by power-law colored noise.
